United States JCI Senate Foundation
   College/University                                                               Scholarship
                                              Application
Eligibility:
    Graduating high school seniors in the United States, who reside in a state that has a JCI
       Senate scholarship chairperson or contact. Check www.usjcisenate.org under the
       scholarship tab for a listing of participating states. If your state does not have a
       chairperson or contact listed, you are not eligible to apply.
    STUDENTS MUST HAVE A GPA OF 3.75 AND ABOVE TO BE CONSIDERED.
    You must be a U.S. citizen to apply for this scholarship.
    You must attend a college or university in the United States to be eligible.
    You must begin your college career in 2027.


This package contains information and directions to apply for the United States JCI
Senate Foundation Scholarship Program. Scholarship grants in amounts of $2000 or $2500
will be awarded to graduating high school seniors in the United States, who plan to
continue their education at an accredited post-secondary college or university within
the United States . Fifty (50) grants will be awarded to 2027 graduates by the United States
JCI Senate Foundation. Scholarships must be used for tuition in the first year of full-
time study immediately following high school graduation. Checks will be made out in the
name of the recipient and will be paid directly to the chosen college/university.

Instructions for the US JCI Senate Foundation Scholarship Application
A. The submission preference will be in a MICROSOFT WORD COMPATABLE FORMAT.
The application must be typed in black ink. Print using single-sided sheets of paper.

B. ON EACH PAGE OF THE APPLICATION PACKAGE, INCLUDE YOUR NAME AND THE
PAGE NUMBER AT THE TOP RIGHT CORNER. (can be neatly hand printed in black ink)
Begin with the checklist as page 1, then continue to number the application and all attachments in
the correct order. If reference letters or transcripts are submitted in sealed envelopes, number the
envelopes for proper placement and the chairman will insert them.
Staple all pages together in the upper left corner.

C. Each student must have an active, working HOME EMAIL ADDRESS listed.

D. All materials MUST be submitted in one mailing.                       Materials sent in
multiple mailings WILL NOT be accepted.

E. Your application will be evaluated by individuals outside of your area.
Do not use acronyms for clubs, events, awards, etc. If the name is not self explanatory, include a
description. Examples: REACH should include a description such as: Oak City REACH Program to
feed the homeless, or J. Smith Award for Top Female Tennis Player.

F. NO ELECTRONIC SUBMISSIONS WILL BE ACCEPTED.
  APPLICATIONS MUST BE POSTMARKED AND MAILED BY JANUARY 12, 2027



                                                                                     SCHOLAR:2026-2027

G. Included in this application package are all the necessary forms and instructions regarding
additional information required.
YOUR APPLICATION PAGES MUST BE SUBMITTED IN THE ORDER LISTED BELOW,
FAILURE TO COMPLY WILL BE CAUSE FOR DISQUALIFICATION.
            STUDENT CHECKLIST
            THE SCHOLARSHIP APPLICATION
                   Applicant Information (section 1)
                   High School Information (section 2)
                   College/University Information (section 3)
                   Parent or Guardian Information (section 4)
                   Financial Statement Information (section 5)
                   Signature of Applicant (section 6)
                  By signing the application, you agree that your name and your
                  photo (if included--section 15) may be used in publications of the
                  US JCI Senate, US JCI Senate Foundation and aff iliated state programs
                   School involvement Page (section 7)
                   Community Involvement Page (section 8)
                   Employment Page (section 9)
                   Personal Statement - 300 to 500 words (section 10)
                   College or University Acceptance Letter - if accepted (section 11)
                   Supporting Documentation – a limit of three pages (section12)
                   Reference Letters – a limit of three, one from an educator (section 13)
                   Transcripts (section 14)
                     Any student with a GPA of 3.75 and above will be considered for this
                     scholarship grant.
                    ACT/SAT test scores should be included if you have taken these tests; insert
                    score papers before the transcripts. NOTE: The ACT/SAT scores are not
                    mandatory, but judging points may awarded for the test scores.
                   Wallet size photo - this is optional but encouraged (section 15)
                    You may include a 2 x 3-inch head shot photo for use in our national
                    publications. This photo should be neatly taped on a sheet of white paper with
                    your name and state listed under the photo. (last page of packet if included)

H. Do not include these first two pages of instructions with your application submission.

I. To submit your application package:
Refer to the website www.usjcisenate.org under the scholarship section. Using the
“State Chairman Contact List” locate the state where you live and submit your
application to the state chairperson or contact listed for that state. If your state
chairperson or contact is not listed, you are not eligible to apply. Do not submit the
application to any address on the web page except to the person listed for your State
Scholarship Contact section; this person listed may be from another state. (packages
submitted to the wrong address will not be forwarded).

YOUR APPLICATION MUST BE POSTMARKED BY JANUARY 12, 2027 .




                                                                                    SCHOLAR:2026-2027

U.S. JCI SENATE FOUNDATION                                                       Student
                                    Application Check List
                                      (College/University)

This check list page is a reminder for you, the applicant, to be sure you have included key points within
your completed application before submission.
Either initial or mark each line after completing.


_____     Include this checklist as page 1 of your application package.

_____ Applicant information is complete with a home email address.

_____ High school information is complete.

_____ College/university information and major is complete.

_____ Parent and/or guardian information is complete.

_____ Completed financial information is based on the first year of education.
            Questions 5-A and 5-B are answered.

_____      Section 6 of the application is signed, and your home email address is
         listed.

_____ Entire application form is complete.
       Sections 7, 8, 9, 10 are each answered on additional sheets of paper.

_____ Personal statement not to exceed 500 words. Word count is included.

_____ Copy of the college/university acceptance letter, if you have received it.

_____ Supporting documentation attached, maximum of 3 sheets.

_____ Reference letters attached, maximum of 3 letters.
       At least one of the reference letters must be from an educator.

_____ School transcripts attached. SAT/ACT scores included if available.

_____ Photo (optional but encouraged)

_____ Name and page number listed at the top right corner of every page of
       the application package.

_____ All pages stapled together at the top left corner.

_____ Application postmarked on or before January 12, 2027.


                                                                                          SCHOLAR:2026-2027

United States JCI Senate Foundation
                                  College/University Scholarship Application

1. APPLICANT INFORMATION
Applicant’s Name                                                                               Date of Application


Applicant’s Home Address                                           Applicant’s Home Email Address


City                                                  State        Zip Code                    Phone Number


Are you a U.S. Citizen (check one)                     _____ Yes   _____ No

2. HIGH SCHOOL INFORMATION
 Name of Applicant’s High School



 Address                                              City                                 State             Zip Code



High School Guidance Counselor OR High School Principal (name, email address, position)




 3. COLLEGE/UNIVERSITY INFORMATION
 Name of College or University you plan to attend AND YOUR MAJOR


 Address                                              City                                 State             Zip Code


  Have you been accepted to this College or University? ___ YES                     ___ NO
  (If yes, attach a copy of the acceptance letter)

  Are you still undecided which school you will attend? ___ YES                     ___ NO

4. PARENT OR GUARDIAN INFORMATION
Father’s Name                                                                                 Check here if father is deceased



Father’s Home Address                                                                         Occupation


City                                                 State             Zip Code               Phone Number




Mother’s Name                                                                                 Check here if mother is deceased



 Mother’s Home Address                                                                        Occupation


 City                                                State             Zip Code               Phone Number




                                                                                                      Form: Scholar-2026-2027

If you have a stepparent or guardian, provide the following information.
Stepparent or Guardian Name


Home Address                                                                                  Occupation


City                                                                                  State   Zip Code         Phone Number




5. APPLICANT’S FINANCIAL STATEMENT INFORMATION
This financial section is to show your understanding of the costs of your education.
BASE THESE EXPENSES ON THE FIRST YEAR OF THE SCHOOL YOU PLAN TO ATTEND.


EXPENSES:            1. Tuition and additional fees                        1. ___________

                   2. Room and board                                2. ___________

                   3. Books, supplies, additional fees                 3. ___________

                    TOTAL ESTIMATED EXPENSES                               ___________



How many family members are financially dependent on your parents/guardians? ___



5-A. FINANCING COLLEGE:
Explain, in detail, how you plan to finance your first year of college.
NOTE: Attach an additional sheet behind this page labeled 5-A. FINANCING COLLEGE.


5-B. FINANCIAL CONSIDERATIONS: (optional)
Explain any personal, family or financial circumstances you believe merit consideration.
NOTE: If you are including this information, attach an additional sheet behind this page,
Labeled 5-B FINANCIAL CONSIDERATIONS.




6. SIGNATURE (You must complete this section)
 I certify that the facts contained in this scholarship application are true and correct. The United States JCI Senate Foundation is
 hereby authorized to verify any information contained in this application. I understand that any falsification of
 misrepresentation will result in disqualification.
 Signature of Applicant                                                                                      Date Signed



 Applicant’s HOME Email Address




                                                                                                           Form: Scholar-2026-2027

7. SCHOOL INVOLVEMENT
List and explain your involvement in school activities, be specific.
Bullet each activity and include any leadership positions, awards, events or projects, and the time commitment involved.
NOTE: Attach an additional sheet behind this page labeled 7. SCHOOL INVOLVEMENT.

8. COMMUNITY INVOLVEMENT
List and explain your involvement in community activities and church activities, be specific.
Bullet each activity and include any leadership positions, awards, events or projects, and the time commitment involved.
NOTE: Attach an additional sheet behind this page labeled 8. COMMUNITY INVOLVEMENT.

9. EMPLOYMENT
Using a bullet format for each job, include the names of employers (including family business or self-employment), job duties, type
of job (occasional, part-time, full-time, summer work, etc.) and pay you received, if any.
If you have not been employed while in high school, please explain any specific reasons.
NOTE: Attach an additional sheet behind this page labeled 9. EMPLOYMENT.




10.     PERSONAL STATEMENT
Complete a statement of 300 to 500 words, indicating your chosen field of study. State your reasons for this choice.
Include pertinent experiences, activities, and accomplishments that have contributed to this decision.
Include word count.
NOTE: Attach an additional sheet behind this page labeled 10. PERSONAL STATEMENT.
\


11. COLLEGE OR UNIVERSITY ACCEPTANCE LETTER (if accepted)

12. SUPPORTING DOCUMENTATION OF YOUR CHOICE (maximum of three (3) pages)
You may include awards, certificates, articles, pictures, etc.


13. REFERENCE LETTERS (maximum of three (3) letters)
At least one reference letter must be from an educator.


14. TRANSCRIPTS
A copy of your current high school transcript MUST be included. This MUST include class grades or scores. Include any college level
courses taken. Include SAT or ACT test scores if you have them.



15. WALLET SIZE PHOTO (optional but encouraged)
You may include a 2 x 3-inch head shot photo for use in our national publications. This photo should be neatly taped on a sheet of
white paper with your name and state listed under the photo.




                                                                                                                Form: Scholar-2026-2027
